<div class="flourish-embed flourish-chart" data-src="visualisation/25644376?515064"><script src="https://public.flourish.studio/resources/embed.js"></script><noscript><img src="https://public.flourish.studio/visualisation/25644376/thumbnail" width="100%" alt="chart visualization" /></noscript></div>
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis
csv_name <- "chartbook_F3.csv"
csv_tmp  <- file.path(tempdir(), csv_name)
download.file(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GPID-WB/pip-chartbook/refs/heads/main/csv/chartbook_F3.csv",
  destfile = csv_tmp,
  mode = "wb",
  quiet = TRUE
)
# Plain <a download> holding the CSV as a data: URI.
# downloadthis::download_file() is deliberately NOT used here: the handler it
# generates calls fetch() on the data: URI, and PositConnect serves a
# Content-Security-Policy whose connect-src has no data:, so the fetch was
# blocked and the button failed with "Download failed. Please try again."
# An anchor download is not governed by any CSP directive.
cat(sprintf(
  '<div class="cell-output-display"><a class="btn btn-primary" href="data:text/csv;base64,%s" download="%s"><i class="bi bi-download"></i> Download data as csv</a></div>',
  xfun::base64_encode(csv_tmp), csv_name
))
```
<p style="font-size: 0.5em; color: #555; margin-top: 0.5em;">

Note: Poverty rates are reported for the $3.00, $4.20, and $8.30 per person per day poverty lines (expressed in 2021 PPP dollars). All observed and projected data are shown with solid and dashed lines, respectively, where dashed data points are cases with insufficient data coverage (i.e., less than 50% of the population have recent survey data).  Data points after 2024 are poverty nowcasts. 

</p>
